author: Inside Edition
description: A growing trend in high-tech deliveries has drones dropping packages right into people's yards. One recent Amazon delivery in Richmond, Texas missed the intended target in a big way. Instead of depositing the package at the front door, it dropped it in a family's swimming pool. So what was inside the package? The homeowner told Inside Edition it contained cat food and insoles for her daughter's shoes. The items were a little damp…but otherwise ok.
title: Amazon Delivery Drone Drops Package Into Swimming Pool #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: Natalie Hall from Ohio is living with three debilitating conditions: Ehlers-Danlos syndrome, tethered cord syndrome, and Chiari malformation. Her symptoms include paralysis, and a disorder in which part of her brain is pushed down through the opening at the base of her skull. Because she was recently diagnosed, Natalie is working to understand her body, make sense of years of unexplained pain, and navigate various complex medical challenges. Inside Edition Digital's Andrea Swindall has more.
title: Woman's Condition Is Pushing Her Brain Out Of Her Skull
